claims.text: The dataset was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower, which facilitated the gathering of conversational dialogs.
The data collection involved manual collection of templates and keywords from frequent expressions used by CF workers during the dataset preparation.
The dataset consists of 1900 dialogs and 8533 turns, aimed at enabling interactive learning and evaluation of dialog systems.
